fieldValues.title: Systems for adding and classifying work: inventory 2026-10-25
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
We have eight separate ways of classifying or authorising work, five GitHub Projects (one, #5, no longer written by anything) and several vocabularies for the same ideas. The owner's goal (vignette 7bfe4a58): one consistent process that is understood; repos may keep localised versions, but the framework stays consistent.

Scope: srs, srs-rust, srs-web, srs-vscode, semanticops.com, muDemocracy.org, clerk, srs-programme, srs-context. Method: label sets and GitHub Project fields as at 2026-10-25, the CLAUDE.md files, the clerk handbook, programme and context records, and the reports already recorded. Not read in depth: the srs RFC process doc and the srs-vscode CLAUDE.md. Label vocabularies were counted, not live issue use.

Each section below is one system, with the conflicts it has with the others. The last two sections map the systems onto the handbook and propose a framework (a proposal, not a ruling).

Corrected 2026-10-25 after a fact-check against origin/master of every repo (the first pass read a local srs-rust checkout 240 commits behind). Section 13 lists the systems the first pass missed.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Five GitHub Projects; #5 (1,347 items) has had no writer since 2026-10-11, when its board sync moved to the clerk.
- One rule (who may merge) has three vocabularies, and muDemocracy.org's AGENTS.md states it two contradictory ways.
- 'What kind of decision is this?' has several answers (modes, cells, layers, the handbook's kinds).
- Effort labels differ by repo: six complexity labels in srs-rust, srs-web has size:m and complexity:high, the practice repos have no complexity at all.
- Nine of the eleven gate:* labels are retired in the label bindings and read by no code, yet still exist in srs and srs-rust.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- Archive Project #5 (and #2, #3, #4)?
- Is the handbook the framework, or one repo's version of it?
